decision_reason: No candidate has both independently verified audio content on the exact proposed rendition and approved item-level processing rights. The 2026-09-09 bounded stream preflight additionally showed that ccp-005 and ccp-006 declare audio tracks but fail the 1,200-second lower duration bound, while the three Omni objects remain HTTP-403 access-blocked and unverified. None of those five is eligible for the long-video pilot core or authorized for acquisition.
